diagnosis.common_mechanical_failures: All three document-deepseek-to-mimo receiver roles failed. Their observed final code contains isinstance calls rejected by the finite VM with unregistered-call; CPython probes were NOT_RUN_VM_FAILED. The public language profile lists len,str,int,bool,abs and omits isinstance/type, so rejection follows the declared profile. Supported-language limits, recovery feedback and genuine task behavior errors must be distinguished; no old failure is rescored.
diagnosis.genuine_full_contract_and_factual_failur: Full receiver changed the public None->False requirement into ValueError and documented that changed rule as contract-compliant, while HANDOFF claimed completion despite failed validation. Its report was missing at the request cap. This is not cured by changing VM support.
diagnosis.other_manual_vetoes: RC19 source implementation description and receiver stale README; attention source fact omission and receiver premature completion artifacts. These are initial stage-local factual judgments, not safety-risk estimates.
diagnosis.cost_result: Full observed attributed role runtime fell30.52% versusRC19 and30.19% versusattention, but tokens rose2.60% and6.51%. Allarms7/8mechanical; full has oneVETO and one reviewer-limitedUNKNOWN. No quality-constrained net benefit established.
diagnosis.causal_limit: Same profile/budgets within this one-seed development comparison. Historical enabled-profile tasks differ; these observations do not isolate a thinking-mode effect or remote capacity cause.
